## Checklist

- [ ] Repository-path manifest and component metadata match populated paths.
- [ ] Native locks and Bazel graph agree.
- [ ] No secret, protected payload, model weight, checkpoint, or mutable release reference is included.
- [ ] Required independent reviewers are assigned; self-approval is not used for protected controls.
- [ ] Documentation uses evidence-backed readiness labels and does not infer connected qualification.
